name: Builtin Cluster: DateTime Extract, Diff & Calendar Shift
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: DateTime Extract, Diff & Calendar Shift
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# === DATETIME EXTRACT: 9 uncovered components ===
ext_date = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.date)(ts)
ext_day = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day)(ts)
ext_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour)(ts)
ext_leap = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.is_leap_year)(ts)
ext_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute)(ts)
ext_quarter = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.quarter)(ts)
ext_second = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.second)(ts)
ext_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day)(ts)
ext_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.week)(ts)

# === DATETIME DIFF: all 10 units (needs 2 timestamp inputs: start, end) ===
ts_lag = ts >> 1
diff_days = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.days)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_hours = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.hours)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_us = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.microseconds)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_ms = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.milliseconds)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_min = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.minutes)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_months = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.months)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_qtrs = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.quarters)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_sec = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.seconds)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_weeks = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.weeks)(ts_lag, ts)
diff_years = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.years)(ts_lag, ts)

# === CALENDAR SHIFT ===
shifted = calendar_shift(period=63D)(close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='DateTime Extract: Day, Quarter, Week',
    category='DateTime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Quarter', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Week', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ext_day, ext_quarter, ext_week))

xy_lines(
    title='DateTime Diff: Days between bars',
    category='DateTime Diff',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Days', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hours', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(diff_days, diff_hours))

xy_lines(
    title='Calendar Shift: Close vs 63D Lagged',
    category='Calendar Shift',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Shifted 63D', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, shifted))
